stops.name: Dunes of Corrubedo Natural Park
stops.detail: Dunes of Corrubedo Natural Park (Galician: Dunas de Corrubedo e Lagoas de Carregal e Vixán) is a 4 square miles (10 km2) natural park on the Atlantic coast of Spain. It is one of six natural parks in the autonomous community of  Galicia. It is situated at the very end of the A Barbanza Peninsula in the province of A Coruña.
